text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mayano Top Gun is taking a break from
her
training to go meet a visitor...

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: Whoa! It's the real Maya—in the flesh!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yup, I'm right here! ☆ Did you come to
see me?

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I was wondering, uh... Please take
this
letter!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Wow, the envelope is so cute! Thanks! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Let's see what's inside. "My dad and I
saw you
race at school."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
You're so strong and cute, Maya! You're
number
one in my heart!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Yep! Would you mind taking a picture
with me?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Copy that! Trainer, could you take the
picture?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Thanks! ♪ Picture in three... two...
one...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Oooh, that came out super nice! ♪ Let's
put some
stickers on it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meeting one of her fans seems to have
upped
Mayano Top Gun's drive.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She heads to practice with a
seldom-seen
enthusiasm.
